events.title: Play the Ecstatica II demo now!
events.summary: Dear horror enthusiasts!The Ecstatica II demo is out now! Experience dark fantasy action-adventure set in a one-of-a-kind world built from ellipsoids and play through roughly the first 20 minutes of the adventure, ahead of the full release on October 26th - just in time for Halloween.The re-release comes with a full suite of enhancements:Runs smoothly on modern hardwareGraphics modes, including Windows 95 (based on the 1997 release) and Software (real-time high resolution render)Switch graphics

events.title: Ecstatica II is coming back!
events.summary: Dear horror enthusiasts!We are happy to announce that in Q4 2026 we will re-release Ecstatica II, a sequel to the cult classic Ecstatica. Released in 1997, it follows the story of the prince and the sorceress Ecstatica with more action-oriented gameplay.Around the same time, we will also re-release the original Ecstatica, a cult survival horror game.The re-release will focus on making sure the game runs smoothly on modern systems.
